To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
rh‐Adiponentin, a novel AdipoR1 agonist, significantly attenuates neuronal apoptosis and reduces brain injury in neonatal rats after HI.
rh‐Adiponetin, a AdipoR ligand, exerts its neuroprotective role via activating Adipo‐R1/APPL‐1/LKB1‐AMPK signaling pathway, thereby attenuating apoptosis in neonatal rats after HI.

Adiponectins attenuated neuronal apoptosis induced by HI in neonatal rats by activating AdipoR‐1/APPL‐1/LKB‐1/AMPK pathways, and thus may be a potential therapeutic target for treatment for neonatal HIE.
